description: Describe what this public server offers and what the separate local server (VigiSky Sentinel, 23 tools, runs on the user's PC) adds: photo and video analysis, night watch, star-field solving. Use it when a task needs local files or a camera, which this server cannot access; for sky questions this server answers directly, call the matching tool (what_did_i_see, iss_city_passes, aurora...). Static description, no network call.
name: capabilities
title: Map of Vigi-Sky MCP servers
